en: Ah...

<CLT=cltMIND>I pulled the device off of my head,
and the real world appeared before me.

Well, Shuichi? Isn't the real world way better
than some virtual reality?

Anywaaay, I felt so lonely without you around.
Apologize for making me feel unloved.
...Hey. There's something I wanted to ask you.

Hm? I tooootally didn't draw anything on your
tummy while you were logged in, okay?
...What?

Nee-heehee, I'm kidding.
So, what was it you wanted to ask?

...You planned to meet Miu on the roof, right?
Did you end up meeting her?

Ooohh, so you know about that, Shuichi.
Impressive, Mister <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Then, I'll tell you what happened.

I never met up with Miu. I couldn't get to
the rooftop cuz it was locked.
Locked?

After, I gave up and went back to the salon to
search for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...Is that true, Kokichi?
Hm? Are you doubting me?

Can someone verify that you were at
the salon the entire time?
Did you meet anyone there?
No, I don't have a witness...

But, you can also say there's *no* witness
who can prove I *wasn't* there!
Unless, you saw the salon empty yourself.

Well, it's up to you whether you wanna
believe me or not...

But you shouldn't doubt me like that!
We're partners!
<CLT=cltMIND>Which one is it...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Did Kokichi meet with Miu or not?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is he lying or telling the truth...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Which is it...?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi In the Salon<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

First you log me out, and now we get called by
Monotaro cuz he needs to tell us something...

I wasn't able to finish investigating Miu's
avatar again...

What are we gonna do!?
I can't clear my name like this!

This no time for sleeping... How come no one
want to do investigation!?
That not gentlemanly at all...!
<CLT=cltMIND>I wasn't sleeping...

Well, it's up to you whether you wanna
believe me or not...

But you shouldn't doubt me like that!
We're partners!

Did you speak to Kokichi about his meeting
with Miu?

He said he didn't meet with Miu. He claimed
the rooftop was locked, so he couldn't enter.

I see... But this is Kokichi we're talking
about. He could very well be lying.
Kokichi never met with Miu...

But this is Kokichi we're talking about...
So he could very well be lying.
*sob* So this is goodbye to my avatar...

Ask Monotaro for the results of the analysis.
I don't know the details yet, either.

In the end...we never found where Monokuma
hid the secret of the outside world.
It seems like it wasn't in the chapel either.

But more importantly, we need to do 
something about Miu's case.

Right now, Miu's case is more important 
than the secret of the outside world.
I've been waiting for you, Shuichi.

I'm sure Maki already told you, but I finally
finished analyzing the program.

I'm starting to put together a lot of important
facts, so here they are!

<CLT=cltMIND>He really is trying to be our friend...
A little bit, at least.

First, the person who tampered with this
program was...Mommy, like we suspected.

Mommy has an eccentric way of writing her
code, so I knew it was her right away.

I guess her personality wasn't the only
eccentric thing about her.
So, what did she tamper with?

A few things...but I'll share the first one
with you.

It looks like Mommy deleted a lot of <CLT=cltSTRONG>objects<CLT=cltNORMAL>
from this killing game simulator.

She said that she deleted anything
that could be used as a weapon.
But in that case, why is there a hammer?

That's true, only the hammer was left.
But why was it left, hm?

The way the program was written makes it
seem like she did it on purpose.
<CLT=cltMIND>On purpose...
Did she *add* anything?
We found a cell phone in the Virtual World...

No, that cell phone was an original feature
of the program.

<CLT=cltMIND>That implies Miu hid that fact
from us. Which means...

All Mommy added were the two maps.
The rest was already part of the program.

By the way, while we're talking about objects,
I wanted to ask you something...

We used the signboard to cross the river, but
could we have used something else as a bridge?

Hmm... I didn't really see anything that could
have been used as a bridge to cross the river.

<CLT=cltMIND>So only that signboard could have
been used as a bridge.
So, what's the next thing she tampered with?

Well, it looks like she also tampered with certain
<CLT=cltSTRONG>parameters<CLT=cltNORMAL> of the program.
Parameters?

Everything in that program is categorized as
either a "<CLT=cltSTRONG>human<CLT=cltNORMAL>" or a "<CLT=cltSTRONG>non-human object<CLT=cltNORMAL>."

Of course, everyone's avatar was assigned
the "<CLT=cltSTRONG>human<CLT=cltNORMAL>" parameter...

But for some reason, Mommy gave her avatar
the "<CLT=cltSTRONG>non-human object<CLT=cltNORMAL>" parameter...

And what happens when you become
an <CLT=cltSTRONG>object<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Well, the difference is only for identification
purposes, so it probably didn't affect anything.

But if it didn't affect anything, then why would
she have gone out of her way to do that?

Perhaps that has something to do with
the next thing she tampered with.

Mommy added a wall that didn't originally
exist in the program.

The coordinates of the Virtual World are
represented on an <CLT=cltSTRONG>X-axis<CLT=cltNORMAL> and a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Y-axis<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

...and it seems Mommy added a wall that runs
the length of the Y-axis.
She created an additional wall?

<CLT=cltMIND>There were walls in all four directions,
and two down the Y-axis...
But...you're positive there was only one?
Yep, it's definitely the only one.
<CLT=cltMIND>What does that mean?
<CLT=cltMIND>Which wall was the one Miu added?

<CLT=cltMIND>What was the world like originally?
Miu said there wasn't anything past the wall.
<CLT=cltMIND>Was that another lie...?

Also, it looks like that extra wall was given
a special setting.

A setting that <CLT=cltSTRONG>allows non-human objects
to pass through it<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
<CLT=cltMIND>It allows objects through?
I see...that's very interesting.
So, are those all the things she tampered with?
Oh, there's one more thing.

So, um, one of you guys also had a strange
setting given to their avatar.
A "strange setting"?

Yeah... The setting made it so <CLT=cltSTRONG>they would be
unable to move if Mommy touched them<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

So...if Miu touched them, their
avatar would be paralyzed?
Who was it?
Ah... It was Kokichi.
Eh, it's me? I didn't know that!

Well, duh, I wouldn't know!
I never touched Miu in that world.
I see, I see. I didn't even notice.

...That's all I have to report.
Well? Do you think it'll help you guys out?

That helps a lot.
...Thanks.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Miu's Avatar<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been updated in the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Wall Added by Miu<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Setting on Kokichi's Avatar<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to
the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

Oh, I should probably tell you this, too.
Though it's probably not related to the case...

Some sorta avatar user error occurred when
you all logged in for the first time.
An error?

The contents of the error are unknown,
so I can't provide any details...

But something strange definitely happened
to someone's avatar when you all logged in.

I don't think anyone's avatar was acting
strange, though...

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of error could it be...?
That's important information...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Avatar Error<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

*sigh* Okay, everyone...
Time for the class trial...

Y'know, that thing where everyone stands
in a circle and talks about the dead body...

...Hm? Low energy? Me?
No, no...I'm excited. Really...

I'm just taking a little break right now...
When I'm done, I'll be my usual energized self.
Yep...I'll be way more energized...
Anyway...that's all.

You seem like you're not into it at all.
We don't have to do the class trial, y'know!

But...it's gonna start, huh?
We no can stop it anymore?
No. We can't.

This is all I can tell you guys, but I don't
want any of you to forget...
I'm your friend!
Huh? He just decided we're friends?
Thank you! Gonta feel relieved!

Don't worry, Monotaro.
Shuichi will get revenge for Miu's death.

And he'll get that revenge...by finding
the culprit among us.

<CLT=cltMIND>...He's right.
The culprit...is someone here.
Thank you everyone! Thank you so much!

When this class trial is over, I hope we
can all get to know each other better!

Nyeeeh...that's the kind of line 
that triggers a death flag.

I...want a fresh start. I want to make up
for my past mistakes.
That too...
Meeting you all...has really...

Sorry, it's nothing. I'll save it for after the
class trial is finished.
Nyeeeh...the flag is rising!

Hm? What was that? I...think I heard
something over there.
I'll go check it out all by myself!
It's waving in the wiiiiiiiiiind!!!
Quit screwing around. Let's hurry up and go.

Gonta do his best, too! Gonta do his best
to be even little bit useful for everyone!

I'm soooo excited! I'll definitely expose
the culprit this time.
Tch... What's so exciting about this!?

<CLT=cltMIND>With conflicting emotions in our hearts,
we headed to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Shrine of Judgment<CLT=cltMIND>.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>From what the time of death indicated
in the Monokuma File...

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu was killed while we were still
in the Virtual World.
Treasure Chest
<CLT=cltMIND>There's a small bottle on the chair.
<CLT=cltMIND>This is a poison that came from my lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>The label contains some information
about the poison...

<CLT=cltMIND>According to the warning,
it's a dangerous poison.

<CLT=cltMIND>Mixing the poison with any solvent will reduce
the effects. It has to be consumed directly.

<CLT=cltMIND>But, even a small amount is
enough to kill an adult.

<CLT=cltMIND>If you could put just a little bit into the
victim's open mouth, they would die instantly.

<CLT=cltMIND>Certainly an effective method for killing
someone who's logged in, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>Something about these listed symptoms
bothers me.

<CLT=cltMIND>This poison causes subconjunctival blood
vessels to hemorrhage.
<CLT=cltMIND>That should cause bloodshot eyes...

<CLT=cltMIND>The person who brought this poison here...
I can't be certain they're the culprit.

<CLT=cltMIND>But, I do know the poison was
placed on *that* person's chair.

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu's hands are clasped around her neck,
as if she were gasping for air.

<CLT=cltMIND>Her eyes are wide open in panic...
She must have suffered quite a bit.

<CLT=cltMIND>The person who found Miu's body was
Keebo, the first to log out.

<CLT=cltMIND>He said that she still had the
helmet on her head at the time.
Still...

What caused her to suffer like this?
What was the cause of death?

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the device we wore on our heads
to enter the virtual world.

<CLT=cltMIND>Some helmets still have their cords plugged
in, others have them removed...
<CLT=cltMIND>My concern is the cords...

<CLT=cltMIND>We were supposed to plug the two cords
from the computer into our helmets.

<CLT=cltMIND>The red for <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltMIND>,
the blue for <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>If they were switched,
glitching might occur.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's what Miu told us...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm interested in the results
of Monotaro's research…
